scope: Read-only re-review of the four ADR 0032 review fixes before conditional local synchronization

baseline.state: Uncommitted 0032 implementation/review changes on a shared dirty checkout; not an isolated commit.
baseline.chatInstructionSource: Pinned official gpt-5.4 catalog template; the current native core must not be assumed to retain its personality interpolation behavior.
baseline.nativePatchNote: Repository packaging-core pin, not the source identity of the currently installed official Desktop CLI.

findings.title: Personality placeholder reaches the upstream model unchanged on the installed core
findings.trigger: Build a Chat catalog with current buildCatalog, start an isolated installed app-server with personality=friendly or personality=pragmatic, and capture the production bridge's outgoing Chat system message.
findings.observed: Both configurations complete the synthetic tool/image turn but fail personality assertions: the system message contains literal {{ personality }} and lacks the selected official style text.
findings.impact: The first review fix restores the placeholder and dictionary but does not achieve the promised runtime style injection. Current tests asserting presence alone give false confidence.
findings.rootBoundary: Current upstream ModelMessages describes instructions_template as literal text and personality selection as unsupported. Removing base_instructions only in the isolated candidate catalog also does not restore interpolation.
findings.requiredResolution: Use an instruction strategy compatible with the target core's capabilities and add real-core assertions that no unresolved slot is sent upstream. Do not modify the native patch chain or claim native personality support without verification.

upstreamCorroboration.note: Current upstream corroborates the observed runtime behavior; main is not asserted to be the exact installed binary revision.

otherReviewItems.evidence: Streaming and non-streaming tool-before-text responses remain commentary; tool-free terminal text becomes final_answer.
Code and documentation agree: opaque output is retained only in that response; encrypted reasoning history is rejected locally with unsupported_input before upstream transmission.
Ajv uses dynamic import. A copied, verified checkout without node_modules skips optionally and fails explicitly in required mode.

additionalNativePersonalityProbe.method: Assert captured instructions after sending a valid synthetic response, so a failed assertion cannot trigger upstream retry timeouts.
sourceVariantChecks: Unmodified buildCatalog: both styles fail with a literal slot.
Isolated candidate with base_instructions removed: both still fail; canonical source is unchanged.

initialProbe.note: Initial assertions inside the upstream responder destroyed connections and caused retry timeouts. That harness was corrected before drawing the finding.

localSynchronization.reason: Blocked by the P1 native personality finding; no launcher replacement, backend staging, retirement, activation or client restart was attempted.
localSynchronization.sourceBinding: The existing MyCodex launcher and active backend are directly bound to /workspace/example/AIBuild/ccodex-release; ccodex-dev sync is a Windows developer entry, not the active Mac path.

cleanup: Owned temporary review copy, synthetic profiles and logs are removed after collecting evidence; the reproducible procedure and results are recorded here.
